def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not all(isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) and arr.ndim == 2 and arr.size > 0
               for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("Each matrix must be a nonempty 2D numpy array.")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All three matrices must have the same shape.")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) and np.all(logp_with_result <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("logp_with_result must be finite and nonpositive.")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) and np.all(logp_call_only <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("logp_call_only must be finite and nonpositive.")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)) and np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("logp_no_call must be finite and nonpositive.")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar and not bool.")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    offsets = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * offsets)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected zero weight sum; future horizon may be zero.")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum  # shape (future_horizon,)

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (negative weighted log probabilities)
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Margins and keep mask
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
